agents.fixwright: @fixwright/engine on scenarioHome(view). The assistant router (@fixwright/router) picks the tool as the live product does: explain_event for questions about something the home did, else the diagnose loop (startDiagnosis, then answerDiagnosis for each question). The simulated person answers its questions; permission questions are granted.

kill_switch.rule: A baseline matches Fixwright on a metric when its 95% Wilson interval overlaps Fixwright's on the same scenarios, or when it is at least as good. The kill switch fires if B1 or B2 matches on both top1 and the false_confirmed rate.
